segments.text: A facelifted Thar lands in 2026 — Roxx looks, bigger screen. So: buy now, or wait?
Today's Thar: 2.0-litre turbo-petrol, 152 PS, 320 Nm. Enough to climb things that were never on the route.
Proper 4x4 on the petrol and the big diesel. The base one is rear-wheel drive — for off-roaders who mostly off-road to brunch.
Prices run ₹10.32 to ₹17.80 lakh. Smart money's on the LXT RWD Diesel, around ₹12.99 lakh — 10.25-inch screen, cruise control, keyless entry, rear camera. All the toys, none of the 4x4 premium.
And if you're buying a Thar for on-road comfort — you're not doing it wrong. You're doing it tragically wrong.
So — today's Thar, or wait for the facelift with its 360 camera and ADAS? Argue in the comments. Follow for more.
